detail.longDescription: 🚀 New release: Grundschutz++ We’re pleased to announce that Grundschutz++ now supports five languages: 🇬🇧 English 🇩🇪 German 🇫🇷 French 🇪🇸 Spanish 🇮🇹 Italian Grundschutz++ is built with 🦀 Rust and provides open-source tooling for BSI Grundschutz and NIS2 security and compliance workflows on Linux and macOS. 🔗 https:// crates.io/crates/grundschutz-o scal-viewer # ndaal # Rust # opensource # Grundschutz # BSI # NIS2 # Linux # macOS
